_meta.title: Jude — key verses (King James Version, public domain)
_meta.description: Curated key verses from the single chapter of Jude. Ecosystem-generic 864zeros content. Each record carries the exact scripture plus an original plain-English rendering.
_meta.license: Public domain (KJV scripture); 'plain' renderings are original 864zeros writing
_meta.source: getbible.net v2 (KJV, book 65 Jude); verses verbatim, curly apostrophes normalized to straight
_meta.selection: key verses from the one chapter (the closing doxology)
_meta.renderings: text = the exact KJV verse; plain = original 864zeros plain-English 2026 rendering, faithful to the verse's meaning (~grade 6-8), authored not quoted.
_meta.note: KJV New Testament renders the divine name as 'Lord'/'God' (no tetragrammaton); text is verbatim KJV. No review gate — author is reviewer.

verses.text: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,
verses.plain: Now to him who is able to keep you from stumbling and to present you before his glorious presence without fault and with great joy,

verses.text: To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.
verses.plain: to the only wise God our Savior be glory, majesty, power, and authority, now and forevermore. Amen.
